programme.title: Hollywood Or Bust
programme.desc: A movie-mad nitwit driving across the country to his mecca, Hollywood, is joined by a gambler who wants to break into singing when they pick up a pretty girl en route. Once in Hollywood the nitwit meets his dream goddess.

programme.title: The Jackie Robinson Story
programme.desc: The legendary Jackie Robinson stars as himself in this inspiring biopic that traces his remarkable ascent from poverty to becoming the first black American to play major league baseball.

programme.title: The Pride of the Yankees
programme.desc: The story of the life and career of famed baseball player Lou Gehrig.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor, Admiral James Greer, becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: East-West tensions erupt when the CIA suspects that renegade Russian scientists are developing more nuclear weapons.

programme.title: Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit
programme.desc: Jack Ryan must quickly evolve from soldier to analyst to full-fledged operative to stop a devastating terrorist plot against the United States.

programme.title: Hush
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: Friday the 13th
programme.desc: Camp Crystal Lake has been shuttered for over 20 years due to several vicious and unsolved murders. The camp's new owner and seven young counselors are preparing the property for reopening despite warnings from residents about a "death curse."

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part II
programme.desc: Five years after the bloodbath at Camp Crystal, all that remains is the legend of Jason and his demented mother, who had murdered seven camp counselors. At a nearby summer camp, the new counselors are unconcerned about the warnings to stay away.

programme.title: Brown Sugar
programme.desc: Two best friends finally realize that they may be in love with each other.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Big Happy Family
programme.desc: When Shirley receives distressing news about her health, it’s up to her Aunt Madea to gather the clan and make things right the only way she knows how: with tough love and laughter.

programme.title: Head of State
programme.desc: When Washington desperately needs a presidential candidate just weeks before the election, they need someone sure to lose. They pick Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), an unknown local politician from a down-and-out D.C. neighborhood, to be their puppet.

programme.title: Reckless
programme.desc: A former convict on parole must outwit the police to get his share of an old heist.

programme.title: Swordsman II [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: Ling Wu Chung decides to hide from the chaotic world. Before leaving, he visits his friends, a tribe of snake-wielding women warriors. However, he finds that the tribe have been attacked, and their leader Yam Ying Ying has been abducted.

programme.title: The Legend [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: This Hong Kong martial-arts extravaganza tells of evil emperors and true love. The secret Red Lotus Flower Society is committed to the overthrow of the evil Manchu Emperor and his minions.

programme.title: Scary Movie
programme.desc: The spoof that started it all. Scream with the Wayans brothers, Carmen Electra, Shannon Elizabeth, and Anna Faris as they bumble and shriek their way to horror-movie hilarity in Scary Movie.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Four teens are tricked by their professor into visiting a haunted house for a school project.

programme.title: Scary Movie 3
programme.desc: David Zucker (AIRPLANE!) directs SCARY MOVIE 3, which piles on hysterical yet gratuitous cameos from thrillers, blockbusters, and pop culture in general, getting its best goosing yet.

programme.title: Serving Sara
programme.desc: Joe Tyler is a process server who will do anything to deliver legal documents to victims. But nothing in Joe's bag of tricks prepares him for Sara, the stunning, soon-to-be ex-wife of a playboy cattle baron named Gordon Moore.

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page are a mother/daughter con team. Max targets wealthy men and marries them. Page then seduces them while Max "catches" her wayward husbands in the act. Then on to the next mark, posing in a variety of guises to keep one step ahead of the law.

programme.title: Runaway Bride
programme.desc: Julia Roberts plays a small-town girl whose marches down the aisle become a series of near Mrs. when she bolts before saying "I do."

programme.title: Under the Silver Lake
programme.desc: When his beautiful, mysterious neighbor disappears without a trace, Sam (Andrew Garfield) tries to find the parties responsible, unraveling a string of strange crimes, unsolved murders, & bizarre coincidences in his East L.A. neighborhood.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: The Silence of the Lambs
programme.desc: An FBI trainee is assigned by her superior to interview an imprisoned, cannibalistic psychopath, Hannibal the Cannibal Lecter, in the hope that he may help uncover the identity of an elusive serial killer.

programme.title: Fat Man and Little Boy
programme.desc: In the remote desert of New Mexico, “The Manhattan Project” is materializing – the World War II effort to build the atomic bomb.

programme.title: Little Man Tate
programme.desc: A single, working-class mother can't give her musically, scientifically and emotionally gifted 7-year-old son the support and stimulation he needs--and neither can the director of a school for exceptional children, who takes him under her wing.

programme.title: Varsity Blues
programme.desc: At first, backup quarterback Jonathan is no football star. But when the starting quarterback is injured, he is thrown into the game and also finds himself in direct conflict with his coach and girlfriend.

programme.title: Out of Liberty
programme.desc: n the winter of 1839, a jailer in Liberty, Missouri, has to watch over the most dangerous men in the state while they await trial. He faces two dangers: the one that comes from the prisoners and the one that lurks behind the walls of the prison.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Texas is at the mercy of murderous bandits. A group of unlikely heroes emerges to battle these renegade outlaws. Out-manned, they summon the courage to protect the innocent and put the wrong things right in their beloved homeland.

programme.title: Stardust
programme.desc: In hopes of wooing a girl, Tristan promises to bring her a falling star. He soon discovers the star is actually a celestial beauty named Yvaine. When an old witch Lamia attempts to steal Yvaine's youth, Tristan must protect her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Join The Addams Family for the most hilarious scarefest of this season or any other! When long-lost Uncle Fester reappears after twenty-five years in the Bermuda Triangle, Gomez and Morticia plan a celebration to wake the dead.

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: The family’s future grows bleak when the no-good nanny marries Fester and has the kids shipped off to summer camp. But Wednesday still has a Thing or two up her sleeve.

programme.title: That Thing You Do!
programme.desc: Are you ready to rock n' roll? The Wonders are here to take you back to a simpler time when being famous was a bit more innocent.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: Dodgeball is back, and this time it’s not just for the schoolyard.

programme.title: Semi-Pro
programme.desc: Will Ferrell and Woody Harrelson take on the world of pro basketball in this hilarious tale of the mythical Flint Michigan Tropics owner, coach, and star player, Jackie Moon, and his quest to take his team all the way to league champions!

programme.title: Mother's Day (2012)
programme.desc: Rebecca DeMornay is terrifying in this brutal gorefest. When her sons break into a home and take the owners hostage, she teaches them what real torture is all about. Costars Shawn Ashmore.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: When four teenagers all meet with mysterious deaths exactly one week after watching a videotape, investigative reporter Rachel Keller tracks down the video... and watches it.

programme.title: The Ring Two
programme.desc: When evidence at a local crime scene reveals a mysterious unmarked videotape, Rachel realizes that Samara is back and more determined than ever to continue her relentless cycle of terror.

programme.title: Pet Sematary (1989)
programme.desc: For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams, the Pet Sematary.

programme.title: The Dead Zone
programme.desc: A man awakens from a coma to discover he has a psychic detective ability.

programme.title: Cujo
programme.desc: While Donna and Vic Trenton struggle to save their rocky marriage, their son Tad befriends the loveable 200-lb St. Bernard who belongs to their mechanic.

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Get ready for thrills in Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion Ravenwood dodge booby-traps, fight Nazis, and stare down snakes in their incredible worldwide quest for the mystical Ark of the Covenant.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round, and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: State Property
programme.desc: Beans decides that the only way to grasp the American Dream is to take it. STATE PROPERTY follows Beans and his crew, as they take over the city creating mayhem as their empire builds.

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City
programme.desc: In these intertwined tales, a universe of unlikely and reluctant heroes try to do the right thing in a city that refuses to care.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: Zoolander
programme.desc: Three-time male model of the year, Derek Zoolander, is devastated when he loses the title to newbie Hansel. After the news, Mugatu's fashion empire brainwashes Derek into being an assassin.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Enter the world of 1970s TV news, where Ron Burgundy and his loyal Channel 4 News Team are San Diego's #1 rated news source. All is well in their male-dominated world of news until rising star reporter Veronica Corningstone turns it upside down.

programme.title: Blades of Glory
programme.desc: Two figure skating rivals are banned from the sport after a brawl over the gold medal. Joining forces, they find a loophole in the rules that allows them to skate again... as a pair!

programme.title: Sleepy Hollow
programme.desc: Johnny Depp is Ichabod Crane, an investigator determined to stop the murderous Headless Horseman.

programme.title: The Crow
programme.desc: Visually stunning and action-packed, this hit movie, based on the comic book series, follows the return from the grave of a young rock guitarist who, along with his fiancée, is brutally killed by a ruthless gang of criminals.

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: A group of small-town high school students discovers their teachers are under the control of mind-controlling alien parasites. From a smart script by Kevin Williamson (SCREAM), and directed by action-expert Robert Rodriguez (FROM DUSK TO DAWN).

programme.title: The Longest Yard (1974)
programme.desc: In this rough-and tumble movie, actually filmed on-location at the Georgia State Prison, the cons are the heroes and the guards are the heavies.

programme.title: Brian's Song
programme.desc: Based on the real-life relationship between teammates Brian Piccolo and Gale Sayers, the bond is established when Piccolo discovers that he is dying.

programme.title: Le Mans
programme.desc: Steve McQueen is an American endurance driver racing the 24 HOURS OF LE MANS in this fast and furious original movie. Filmed on location throughout the Le Mans circuit, with jaw dropping car crash stunts and heart-pounding action.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: After years of hiding from a society that shuns him, Hellboy and his team attempt to stop the resurrection of an ancient witch who once spread an unstoppable plague before she was locked away by the legendary King Arthur.

programme.title: Universal Soldier
programme.desc: A woman reporter discovers a Defense Department project to create androids from the bodies of Vietnamese soldiers, to be then used as an elite anti-terrorism unit.

programme.title: World War Z
programme.desc: World War Z is the fast-paced, pulse-pounding epic of the potential last days of the human race. Former United Nations employee Gerry Lane (Brad Pitt) is called in to help stop the pandemic from spreading worldwide.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Winner of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which a crime-scene's irresistible stolen loot sets forth an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: Heist

programme.title: The Hound Of The Baskervilles (1959)
programme.desc: A hellish hound feeds upon the flesh of the heirs of Baskerville Hall. But before this beast can sink its teeth into the newest lord, it must pit its vicious fangs against the searing intellect of Sherlock Holmes (Peter Cushing) and Dr. Watson.

programme.title: Roman Holiday
programme.desc: Audrey Hepburn's portrayal of a modern-day princess, rebelling against the royal obligations, who explores Rome on her own. This romantic comedy ranks as one of the most enjoyable films of all times.

programme.title: Funny Face
programme.desc: Paris, the City of Light, shines even brighter when Audrey Hepburn and Fred Astaire team up for the only time and bring their luminous starpower to this exquisite musical featuring songs by George and Ira Gershwin.

programme.title: 13 Hours: The Secret Soldiers of Benghazi
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay, 13 HOURS is the gripping true story of six elite ex-military operators assigned to protect the CIA who fought back against overwhelming odds when terrorists attacked a U.S. diplomatic compound on September 11, 2012.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back and gain the freedom of his people in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Shooter
programme.desc: Determined to prove his innocence in a double-cross, Bob Lee Swagger is now in a high-tension race from every law enforcement agency in the US and a shadowy organization that wants him dead.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part - IV: The Final Chapter
programme.desc: After his revival in a hospital morgue, the hockey-masked murderer fixes his vengeful attention on the Jarvis family and a group of hitherto carefree teenagers.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part V: A New Beginning
programme.desc: This time, he seems to have set his sights on the young patients at a secluded halfway house. And more than a few of his teen targets end up in half, in quarters... You name it, Jason does it.

programme.title: Friday the 13th, Part VI: Jason Lives
programme.desc: As a child, Tommy Jarvis did what many others died trying to do. He killed Jason Vorhees, the mass murderer who terrorized the residents of Crystal Lake. But now, years later, Tommy is tormented by the fear that maybe Jason isn’t really dead.

programme.title: Good Burger
programme.desc: Kenan & Kel are serving up laughs! They're the good guys in Good Burger, a zany comedy inspired by the popular Kel routine from Nickelodeon's hit series All That.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: With showstopping performances by a star-studded cast, Dreamgirls soars with the amazing story of three female singers who learn that anything is possible when you hold on to your dreams.

programme.title: Albany Road
programme.desc: On her way to the most important meeting of her career, a New York executive is forced to share a rental car with her ex-fiancé's mother, only to discover that the mother is hiding a major secret.

programme.title: The Legend 2 [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: The Cantonese hero Fong Sai Yuk becomes involved in the secret brotherhood "The Red Flower", who are trying to overthrow the Manchurian emperor and re-establishing the Ming dynasty.

programme.title: Tai Chi Master [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: Two friends, ex Shaolin monks, part ways as they brush with the ongoing rebellion against the government. The ambitious one rises up to be a powerful military commander, while his betrayed friend resorts to learn the calm ways of Tai Chi.

programme.title: Legend of the Red Dragon
programme.desc: A young father and his infant son are beset by forces of evil and corruption. They wander China, upholding their sense of honor and protecting the weak. When they are forced into combat, spectacular and hilarious fast-motion kung fu sequences follow.

programme.title: Scary Movie 5
programme.desc: Home with their newly-formed family, happy parents Dan and Jody are haunted by sinister, paranormal activities — disrupting new mama Jody’s dancing aspirations in the “Swan Lake” ballet and threatening Dan’s rise as an ape researcher.

programme.title: The Dictator
programme.desc: Featuring never-before-seen footage that's outrageously funny! The creators and star of Borat bring you the hilarious comedy about what happens when the world's worst dictator is stuck in New York.

programme.title: Scary Movie
programme.desc: The spoof that started it all. Scream with the Wayans brothers, Carmen Electra, Shannon Elizabeth, and Anna Faris as they bumble and shriek their way to horror-movie hilarity in Scary Movie.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: A US West Coast teen lifestyle parody centered around Cher, a popular high school girl who spends her days playing match-maker, helping her friends with fashion choices, and looking for a boyfriend.

programme.title: 10 Things I Hate About You
programme.desc: Cameron instantly falls for the girl of his dreams.

programme.title: John Tucker Must Die
programme.desc: Cheerleaders use a newcomer to exact revenge on their cheating boyfriend.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Widow and mother of three, Annie Wilson makes her living by foretelling others' futures...though her own has become cloudier than even she can see.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: The Pelican Brief
programme.desc: Academy Award winners Julia Roberts and Denzel Washington star in this thriller about a young law student whose theory about the recent deaths of two Supreme Court justices embroils her in a web of greed, corruption, and murder.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Demi Moore and Woody Harrelson are Diana and David Murphy, a financially strapped couple who are betting on a quick trip to Las Vegas to deal them a lucky hand. But the odds are suddenly even more attractive when billionaire John Gage ups the ante.

programme.title: The Truman Show
programme.desc: Truman doesn’t realize that his quaint hometown is a giant studio set run by a visionary producer/director/creator (Ed Harris), that folks living and working there are Hollywood actors, and that even his incessantly bubbly wife is a contract player.

programme.title: Fat Man and Little Boy
programme.desc: In the remote desert of New Mexico, “The Manhattan Project” is materializing – the World War II effort to build the atomic bomb.

programme.title: Outlaw Posse
programme.desc: In 1908, Chief (Mario Van Peebles) returns from years of hiding to claim stolen gold. In his quest, he reunites an ensemble of familiar faces. Together, they fight off Angel, whose desire for the gold leaves a trail of dead bodies.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: The Brothers Grimm
programme.desc: In this visionary film, Will and Jake Grimm dazzle small towns with their imaginative folklore and elaborate illusions, only to discover that many of the fantastic characters and thrilling situations from their beloved fairy tales are real.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Caddyshack
programme.desc: It's the snobs against the slobs! While caddy Danny tries to impress elitist Judge Smails, a crude construction tycoon tries to get accepted at the country club, and a groundskeeper stalks a gopher.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: Dodgeball is back, and this time it’s not just for the schoolyard.

programme.title: Semi-Pro
programme.desc: Will Ferrell and Woody Harrelson take on the world of pro basketball in this hilarious tale of the mythical Flint Michigan Tropics owner, coach, and star player, Jackie Moon, and his quest to take his team all the way to league champions!

programme.title: Hereditary
programme.desc: When the matriarch of the Graham family passes away, her daughter (Toni Collette) and grandchildren begin to unravel cryptic and increasingly terrifying secrets about their ancestry, trying to outrun the sinister fate they have inherited.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: When four teenagers all meet with mysterious deaths exactly one week after watching a videotape, investigative reporter Rachel Keller tracks down the video... and watches it.

programme.title: The Ring Two
programme.desc: When evidence at a local crime scene reveals a mysterious unmarked videotape, Rachel realizes that Samara is back and more determined than ever to continue her relentless cycle of terror.

programme.title: Pet Sematary (1989)
programme.desc: For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams, the Pet Sematary.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: American Gigolo (1980)
programme.desc: Julian Kay has it all: the Mercedes, the clothes, access to Beverly Hills' swankiest establishments, and a stable of rich, female clients. But it all falls apart after he does a favor for his former pimp and the trick turns up dead a short while later.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS present Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull. Join Indy as he races against a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator in this thrilling adventure!

programme.title: Eagle Eye
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf and Michelle Monaghan star as two strangers trying to escape danger when they are ripped from their ordinary lives and 'activated' as part of a hightech assassination plot.

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: When mysterious spacecraft touch down across the globe, an elite team - led by expert translator Louise Banks (Academy Award® nominee Amy Adams) – races against time to decipher their intent.

programme.title: The Whole Nine Yards
programme.desc: An unhappy dentist in Montreal gets a new neighbor, Jimmy 'The Tulip' Teduski, a former mob hitman turned informant with a price on his head.

programme.title: The Big Lebowski
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges, John Goodman, Steve Buscemi and Julianne Moore star in this Coen brothers’ cult comedy about the Dude, his buddies, a case of mistaken identity, kidnapping and bowling.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: Zoolander
programme.desc: Three-time male model of the year, Derek Zoolander, is devastated when he loses the title to newbie Hansel. After the news, Mugatu's fashion empire brainwashes Derek into being an assassin.

programme.title: School of Rock
programme.desc: Jack Black stars as a guitarist with delusions of grandeur. Kicked out of his band and looking for work, he becomes a substitute teacher and turns his class into rock and rollers.

programme.title: This Is Spinal Tap
programme.desc: Undoubtedly the funniest film ever made about rock and roll, Rob Reiner's satire about an over-the-hill heavy metal band is a priceless look at the music business and its madness.

programme.title: Idle Hands
programme.desc: The devil will find work for idle hands to do, but what happens when he chooses the laziest teen slacker in the world to do his dirty work? Anton Tobias is a couch potato burnout who can't control the murderous impulses of his possessed hand. Rated: R

programme.title: Romy and Michele's High School Reunion
programme.desc: Two friends try to reinvent themselves to impress old classmates.

programme.title: Dick
programme.desc: The year is 1972, and Betsy Jobs and Arlene Lorenzo just want to have a good time. But during a class field trip to the White House, they cluelessly wander into a behind-closed-doors, top-secret shredding session. Rating: PG-13

programme.title: The Longest Yard (1974)
programme.desc: In this rough-and tumble movie, actually filmed on-location at the Georgia State Prison, the cons are the heroes and the guards are the heavies.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Hair
programme.desc: A country boy and Vietnam draftee embark on an adventure of a lifetime when he meets a group of counterculture hippies and his eyes are opened to the darker side of class, race, and big city life in this adaptation of the Broadway sensation.

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: Nothing can prepare you for the mind-blowing mayhem that is Overlord. Mega producer J.J. Abrams creates an insanely twisted thrill ride about a team of American troops who come face-to-face with Nazi super-soldiers unlike the world has ever seen.

programme.title: Crawl
programme.desc: As a hurricane tears through Florida, Haley rushes to find her father, who is injured and trapped in the crawl space of their home. With the storm intensifying and water levels rising, the pair faces an even greater threat lurking beneath the surface.

programme.title: Rogue
programme.desc: A rugged American adventure-travel journalist on assignment in the Australian outback encounters a man-eating crocodile.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Winner of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which a crime-scene's irresistible stolen loot sets forth an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity
programme.desc: After a young, middle-class couple moves into what seems like a typical suburban house, they become increasingly disturbed by a presence that may or may not be demonic and active at night.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 2
programme.desc: As a couple welcomes a newborn baby into their home, a demonic presence begins terrorizing them, tearing apart their perfect world and turning it into an inescapable nightmare.

programme.title: Escape the Field
programme.desc: Stripped of their possessions, six strangers wake up in a remote, endless cornfield with six items. They soon realize they're in a mysterious cat-and-mouse game with an unseen evil, and survival depends upon solving a diabolical and deadly puzzle.

programme.title: Outback
programme.desc: An American couple fight for survival after getting lost in the Australian Outback.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: A war-hardened Crusader and his Moorish commander mount an audacious revolt against the corrupt English crown.

programme.title: Power Rangers
programme.desc: A group of high-school students, who are infused with unique superpowers, harness their abilities in order to save the world.

programme.title: Boomerang
programme.desc: Advertising executive Marcus Graham is a quintessential bachelor. Graham is never without a new lady on his arm. Enter Jacqueline, his new boss, and Marcus is on the receiving end of his own patented behavior for the first time!

programme.title: The Golden Child
programme.desc: As ‘The Chosen One’, Murphy’s on a madcap mission to save The Golden Child, a youth with mystical powers who’s been abducted by an evil cult.

programme.title: 48 Hrs.
programme.desc: Nolte is a rough-edged cop after two vicious cop-killers. He can't do it without the help of smooth Murphy, who is serving time for a half-million-dollar robbery.

programme.title: Down in the Delta
programme.desc: In Maya Angelou's directorial debut, a troubled single mother spends the summer at her family's ancestral home in rural Mississippi and learns to reverse the downward slide of her life in this uplifting story of family, community and friendship.

programme.title: House Party
programme.desc: When party time comes, it's time to tear the house down! If they get caught, it's all over. But if they don't, it's just the beginning! Kid 'N Play stars in the uproarious comedy that launched the House Party craze.

programme.title: House Party 2
programme.desc: High school is over, but the party is not. Join Kid n' Play for a hip-hop college adventure in House Party 2. Kid decides to pursue college, but when Play loses Kid's tuition money, the two boys have to devise a new plan -the wildest one yet!

programme.title: Terminator Genisys
programme.desc: When John Connor sends Kyle Reese back to 1984 to protect a young Sarah Connor, unexpected events alter the past and threaten the future for all mankind. Charged with a new mission, Reese must join forces with Sarah and her "Guardian" to save the world.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: It's 2084 A.D., and Doug Quaid is haunted by recurring dreams about journeying to Earth's closest planetary neighbor, Mars.

programme.title: Virtuosity
programme.desc: He’s a composite of some 200 personalities, every one a notorious killer. He’s Sid 6.7, a virtual reality creation designed to put L.A. police officers to the test.

programme.title: Rocky IV
programme.desc: East meets West when Rocky (Sylvester Stallone) takes on a vicious Soviet fighter (Dolph Lundgren) with a deadly punch in a match that means not only defending himself, but also defending the honor of his country and the memory of an old friend.

programme.title: Rocky V
programme.desc: Broke and injured after his bout with Russian powerhouse Ivan Drago, Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) must rediscover his roots in this thrill-packed drama that reunites Stallone with John G. Avildsen, the Oscar®-winning director of 'Rocky.'

programme.title: Rocky Balboa
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone is back in this action-packed sequel, and this time he's up against an opponent (Antonio Tarver) who's faster, stronger, and 30 years his junior! Milo Ventimiglia and Burt Young are ringside for the hard-hitting battle of the ages!

programme.title: Nobody's Fool (2018)
programme.desc: Tiffany Haddish is hysterical in Tyler Perry's most outrageous comedy yet. Wild child Tanya looks to her buttoned-up sister Danica to get back on her feet. As these opposites collide, Tanya learns that Danica's perfect life may not be what it seems.

programme.title: Top Five
programme.desc: Written, directed and starring Chris Rock, TOP FIVE tells the story of New York City comedian-turned-film star Andre Allen, whose unexpected encounter with a journalist forces him to confront the comedy career—and the past—that he’s left behind.

programme.title: Head of State
programme.desc: When Washington desperately needs a presidential candidate just weeks before the election, they need someone sure to lose. They pick Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), an unknown local politician from a down-and-out D.C. neighborhood, to be their puppet.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and New York during the 1910s, then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America, along with the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: Spy Kids 3: Game Over
programme.desc: Antonio Banderas, Carla Gugino, Alexa Vega, and Daryl Sabara return in this third installment of the popular SPY KIDS trilogy that finds Carmen kidnapped by an evil Toymaker (Sylvester Stallone) and imprisoned inside a virtual reality game.

programme.title: Spy Kids 4: All the Time in the World
programme.desc: The action packed franchise is back…with the next generation of Spy Kids!

programme.title: No Country For Old Men

programme.title: Scary Movie 4

programme.title: Baggage Claim
programme.desc: Montana Moore is determined to get engaged before her sister’s wedding in just 30 days!

programme.title: What's Love Got to Do With It?

programme.title: I Love You, Man
programme.desc: A friendless groom-to-be meets the ultimate dude and the two begin a "bro-mance" which takes male-bonding to hilarious new heights that will keep you laughing to the end.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Widow and mother of three, Annie Wilson makes her living by foretelling others' futures...though her own has become cloudier than even she can see.

programme.title: Blue Velvet
programme.desc: A sensual mystery thriller about strange happenings in a small North Carolina town. A college student stumbles across a bizarre mystery and wants to know more, perhaps too much more.

programme.title: The Silence of the Lambs
programme.desc: An FBI trainee is assigned by her superior to interview an imprisoned, cannibalistic psychopath, Hannibal the Cannibal Lecter, in the hope that he may help uncover the identity of an elusive serial killer.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Demi Moore and Woody Harrelson are Diana and David Murphy, a financially strapped couple who are betting on a quick trip to Las Vegas to deal them a lucky hand. But the odds are suddenly even more attractive when billionaire John Gage ups the ante.

programme.title: Sense and Sensibility
programme.desc: Emma Thompson stars in the captivating romance based on Jane Austen's classic novel of two sisters' search for love in strict Victorian society.

programme.title: The English Patient
programme.desc: Unforgettable and powerful, this winner of 9 Academy Awards, including Best Picture, Best Director (Anthony Minghella) and Best Supporting Actress (Juliette Binoche) unfolds an incredible tale of passion, intrigue, and adventure.

programme.title: Outlaws and Angels
programme.desc: When Outlaws on the lam invade the home of an unsuspecting, seemingly innocent frontier family to hide out for the night, an unexpected game of cat and mouse ensues, leading to seduction, role reversal, and ultimately, bloody revenge.

programme.title: Bull
programme.desc: Kris is forced to help her neighbor, an ex-bull rider scraping by on the Texas rodeo circuit.

programme.title: Frank and Jesse
programme.desc: After the defeat of the South in the Civil War and the murder of their younger brother, Frank and Jesse James seek their own brand of justice. As outlaws, they gain fame for their daring hold-ups of banks, trains, and stagecoaches.

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: On a mission to protect Earth, the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee is found and repaired by a teenager named Charlie. They must work together to save the planet from the evil Decepticons in this action-packed adventure for the whole family.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Caddyshack
programme.desc: It's the snobs against the slobs! While caddy Danny tries to impress elitist Judge Smails, a crude construction tycoon tries to get accepted at the country club, and a groundskeeper stalks a gopher.

programme.title: Juwanna Mann
programme.desc: A basketball star is booted out of the NBA when his on-court antics go too far, so he poses as a woman and joins the WUBA. Rated PG-13

programme.title: Mary Shelley's Frankenstein
programme.desc: When the brilliant but unorthodox scientist Dr. Victor Frankenstein rejects the artificial man that he has created, the Creature escapes and later swears revenge.

programme.title: It Follows
programme.desc: After a seemingly innocent sexual encounter, 19-year-old Jay becomes trapped by a vicious curse - "it" is following her, and the only way to save herself is to put others in harm's way.

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: Author Kipps (Daniel Radcliffe), a widowed lawyer, is sent to a remote village to sort out the affairs of a recently deceased eccentric. But upon his arrival, it soon becomes clear that everyone in the town is keeping a deadly secret.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: On the 11th May 1969, troops of the 101st Airborne Division engaged the enemy at the base of Hill 937 in the Ashau Valley. Ten days and eleven bloody assaults later, the troops who fought there called it Hamburger Hill.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: The Accused (1988)
programme.desc: Jodie Foster gives an Oscar-winning performance as the hard, independent Sarah Tobias, who is assaulted in the back of a neighborhood bar. But that is only the beginning of her ordeal.

programme.title: The Island
programme.desc: A man goes on the run after he discovers that he is actually a "harvested being", and is being kept along with others in a utopian facility.

programme.title: Overdrive
programme.desc: Scott Eastwood stars in this action-adventure from the writers of 2 Fast 2 Furious and the director of Taken. When two legendary car thieves are caught stealing from a mafia boss, they are given a week to nab a vintage Ferrari, or risk losing everything.

programme.title: To Live And Die In L.A.
programme.desc: Federal agent Richard Chance has a score to settle, and he's through playing by the rules. He vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary. But as the stakes grow higher, will Chance's obsession ultimately destroy him?

programme.title: City of God
programme.desc: This critically acclaimed global hit film is a true story of crime and redemption set in one of the most notorious slums: Rio de Janeiro's "City of God."

programme.title: Wayne's World
programme.desc: When a sleazy TV exec offers Wayne and Garth a contract to tape their late-night cable-access show at his network, they discover the road to the big time is full of gnarly twists and turns.

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure
programme.desc: Our non-heinous heroes Bill (Alex Winter) and Ted (Keanu Reeves) are in danger of flunking history! But when the righteous Rufus (George Carlin) arrives in a time-travelling phone booth, the dense dudes discover their destiny!

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Bogus Journey
programme.desc: In this sequel to BILL & TED'S EXCELLENT ADVENTURE, the dimwitted duo travel to Heaven, Hell and points in between as they meet (among others) Albert Einstein, the Easter Bunny and the Grim Reaper.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: A US West Coast teen lifestyle parody centered around Cher, a popular high school girl who spends her days playing match-maker, helping her friends with fashion choices, and looking for a boyfriend.

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Reese Witherspoon plays Tracy Flick, a straight-A go-getter determined to be president of Carver High’s student body. Popular teacher Jim McAllister (Broderick) decides to derail Tracy’s obsessive overachieving by recruiting an opposition candidate.

programme.title: Dick
programme.desc: The year is 1972, and Betsy Jobs and Arlene Lorenzo just want to have a good time. But during a class field trip to the White House, they cluelessly wander into a behind-closed-doors, top-secret shredding session. Rating: PG-13

programme.title: Rockers
programme.desc: Night Flight Presents: Starring Leroy 'Horsemouth' Wallace and Richard 'Dirty Harry' Hall; ROCKERS is a story of oppressed Jamaican musicians getting even with the 'mafia types' in the business

programme.title: Foul Play
programme.desc: Beware of the Dwarf, whispers the hitchhiker to the beautiful librarian as he dies through a screening of This Gun Is Mine. Suddenly, Hawn is propelled into a world of wild chases and deadly encounters with an assortment of weird characters.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: In this thrilling cult classic, two dangerous outlaw brothers head out on a wild crime spree. After kidnapping a father and his two kids, the bad guys head to a seedy Mexican bar for safety, but come face to face with blood-sucking vampires.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: After years of hiding from a society that shuns him, Hellboy and his team attempt to stop the resurrection of an ancient witch who once spread an unstoppable plague before she was locked away by the legendary King Arthur.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 4
programme.desc: Katie disappeared with her nephew, Hunter, and there were no survivors. Five years later, she's returned with a mysterious boy, ready to target new victims with her demonic rage in a quiet neighborhood.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: For the first time, you will SEE the activity... When a new family moves into a familiar house, they discover a mysterious video camera that reveals a demonic threat and soon find themselves terrorized by an ancient evil.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Marked Ones
programme.desc: The activity is back and has claimed a new victim. Jesse has been hearing horrifying sounds from his neighbor’s apartment, but when he sets out to uncover their source, he encounters an ancient evil that won’t rest until it’s claimed his soul.

programme.title: Escape the Field
programme.desc: Stripped of their possessions, six strangers wake up in a remote, endless cornfield with six items. They soon realize they're in a mysterious cat-and-mouse game with an unseen evil, and survival depends upon solving a diabolical and deadly puzzle.

programme.title: Outback
programme.desc: An American couple fight for survival after getting lost in the Australian Outback.

programme.title: Mechanic: Resurrection
programme.desc: Bishop's most formidable foe kidnaps the love of his life in order to make him complete three impossible assassinations and make them look like accidents.

programme.title: Another 48 Hrs.

programme.title: Boomerang

programme.title: The Golden Child

programme.title: The Players Club

programme.title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead (2024)

programme.title: School Dance
programme.desc: High school freshman Jason has found his dream girl, but there's just one problem: she doesn't know he exists.

programme.title: Déjà Vu
programme.desc: If you thought it was just a trick of the mind, prepare yourself for the truth.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: It's 2084 A.D., and Doug Quaid is haunted by recurring dreams about journeying to Earth's closest planetary neighbor, Mars.

programme.title: Creed
programme.desc: Adonis Johnson (Michael B Jordan) never knew his father, heavyweight champion Apollo Creed, who died before he was born. But, with boxing in his blood, he heads to Philadelphia to convince the retired Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) to train him.

programme.title: Creed II
programme.desc: The next chapter in the Creed story follows Adonis Creed's life inside and outside the ring as he deals with newfound fame, family issues, and his ongoing quest to become a champion, with Michael B. Jordan and Sylvester Stallone starring.

programme.title: Creed III
programme.desc: After dominating the boxing world, Adonis Creed has been thriving in his career and family life. But now he puts his future on the line to battle a fighter -- and former friend -- who has absolutely nothing to lose…and everything to gain.

programme.title: Pootie Tang
programme.desc: When Pootie’s one-man war against greed, injustice, and unwholesome consumer products starts cutting into profits at LecterCorp, the company’s demented CEO plunges him into a super-funk by swiping his magical belt!

programme.title: The Honeymooners
programme.desc: Bus driver Ralph Kramden and sanitation engineer Ed Norton are best friends who dream of making it big. Their most recent “get-rich-quick” plan finds the boys out to make their fortune by hiring a dog trainer to race their pet greyhound.

programme.title: Head of State
programme.desc: When Washington desperately needs a presidential candidate just weeks before the election, they need someone sure to lose. They pick Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), an unknown local politician from a down-and-out D.C. neighborhood, to be their puppet.

programme.title: The Godfather

programme.desc: Auftakt zur South Park Jubiläums Reihe anlässlich des 15 jährigen Geburtstags der Serie. Dieses Mal moderiert Cartman die Show unter dem Motto 'Cartman in Control'.

programme.title: South Park: Mannbärschwein
programme.desc: Die Jungs begehen einen großen Fehler, als sie Al Gore in eine Höhle folgen, um ein angeblich mutiertes Mischwesen aufzuspüren. Durch einen Erdrutsch wird die Höhle verschüttet - jetzt heißts, ums Überleben kämpfen!

programme.title: South Park: Tsst!
programme.desc: Cartmans Mutter kommt zu dem Schluss, dass sie ihren Sohn nicht länger unter Kontrolle hat. Cesar 'Der Hundeflüsterer' Millan soll ihr dabei helfen, wieder einen Zugang zu Cartman zu finden. Dieser aber beschließt, sich mit allen Mitteln zu wehren!

programme.title: South Park: Gott ist tot
programme.desc: Inspiriert vom Unterricht in der Schule versucht Cartman alles, um in die Zukunft zu gelangen ohne etwas von der Gegenwart mitzukriegen. Was böte sich da eher an, als sich einzufrieren?

programme.title: South Park: Gott ist tot II
programme.desc: Nachdem sich Cartman eingefroren hat um die Zeit zum Wii-Launchtermin nicht mitkriegen zu müssen, erwacht er 500 Jahre zu spät aus seinem eisigen Schlaf. Die Zukunft gefällt ihm überhaupt nicht.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman Sucks
programme.desc: Cartman hat ein neues Hobby entdeckt: In regelmäßigen Abständen verabredet er sich mit Butters zum Übernachten. Während Butters schläft, macht Cartman dann peinliche Fotos von ihm.

programme.title: South Park: Ein bisschen Tourette
programme.desc: Cartman entdeckt die Vorzüge des Tourette Syndroms, bei dem die Betroffenen unkontrolliert Fluchen. So nimmt er das Syndrom als Freibrief, in der Schule als Simulant alle möglichen Schimpfworte vor sich herzubrüllen.

programme.title: South Park: Ärger mit den Mandeln
programme.desc: Nach einer Mandel-OP wird bei Cartman festgestellt, dass er mit dem HIV Virus infiziert ist. Kyle macht sich darüber lustig, woraufhin Cartman ihn absichtlich mit dem Virus ansteckt.

programme.title: Polizeiruf 110: Heiße Münzen
programme.desc: Zwei Tage vor einer Ausstellungseröffnung haben unbekannte Täter die wertvollsten Münzen aus einem Museum gestohlen. Unzureichende Sicherheitsvorkehrungen haben es den Dieben leicht gemacht.

programme.title: Polizeiruf 110: Ein Fall ohne Zeugen
programme.desc: In einer belebten Berliner Geschäftsstraße wird ein erst zehn Tage alter Säugling entführt. Die Mutter glaubt zunächst an einen Scherz, da niemand der Umstehenden etwas bemerkt haben will.

programme.title: Polizeiruf 110: Der Mann
programme.desc: Franz Werker ist nach einem Tötungsdelikt vorzeitig aus der Haft entlassen worden. In einer Straßenbahnbrigade soll er wieder Fuß fassen. Doch die meisten Kollegen stehen ihm skeptisch gegenüber.

programme.title: Polizeiruf 110: Heiße Münzen
programme.desc: Zwei Tage vor einer Ausstellungseröffnung haben unbekannte Täter die wertvollsten Münzen aus einem Museum gestohlen. Unzureichende Sicherheitsvorkehrungen haben es den Dieben leicht gemacht.

programme.title: South Park: Der Coon 2
programme.desc: Die Superheldenliga Coon & Friends hat sich formiert - unter der Führung von Cartman alias Coon haben die Jungs viel zu tun: Krisen, Katastrophen und Unglücke passieren am laufenden Band. Doch dann erscheint ein anderer Superheld auf der Bildfläche.

programme.title: South Park: Böser, böser Fisch
programme.desc: Mrs. Marshs schenkt Stan einen Goldfisch und kurze Zeit später bewahrheiten sich Stans düstere Vorahnungen: der Fisch tötet zwei Menschen, die Stans Mutter kurzerhand im Garten vergräbt, weil sie ihren Sohn für den Täter hält und ihn beschützen will.

programme.title: South Park: Regenwald, Regenwald du lässt mich völlig kalt
programme.desc: Mr. Mackey zwingt die Jungs dazu, beim Chor 'Geile Sachen mit Kindern' mitzumachen, welcher beim bevorstehenden Wohltätigkeitskonzert in Costa Rica zur Erhaltung des Regenwalds teilnehmen soll.

programme.title: South Park: Chefkoch liebt 'nen Sukkubus!
programme.desc: Kyle und Stan sind entsetzt: ihr Freund Chefkoch ist in die Fänge eines verführerischen Monsters in Gestalt einer schönen Frau verfallen und er kann sich nicht mehr länger um die Sorgen und Nöte der Jungs kümmern.

programme.title: South Park: Korns echt abgefahrene Geisterstory
programme.desc: Wieder einmal ist Halloween in South Park und Ärger steht ins Haus. Pfarrer Maxi verkündet die Halloweenfeiern als Werke des Bösen und am Pier, wo die Feierlichkeiten abgehalten werden sollen, erscheinen plötzlich Piratengeister.

programme.title: South Park: Kenny ist in Cartman drin!
programme.desc: Cartman hat immer noch Kenny's nervenden Geist in seinem Körper. Den will er mit Hilfe eines Fernsehmediums vertreiben, merkt aber schnell, dass das Medium ein Flop ist.

programme.title: South Park: Pandemie 2 - Das Erstaunliche
programme.desc: Riesige Meerschweinchen greifen Städte überall auf der Welt an. Die Jungs haben den Schlüssel, der die Menschheit retten kann, aber sie sitzen in den Anden fest.

programme.title: South Park: Butters im Bann der Dämonen
programme.desc: Butters ist davon überzeugt, in der Schule einen Vampir gesehen zu haben - er wendet sich an seine Mitschüler, aber niemand glaubt ihm.

programme.title: South Park: Tote Promis
programme.desc: Der kleine Bruder von Kyle sieht tote Menschen und keine Geringeren als die Stars, die im Laufe des letzten Jahres verstorben sind, wie Michael Jackson oder Patrick Swayze. Stan, Kyle, Cartman und Kenny versuchen Ike mit allen Mitteln zu helfen.

programme.title: Perry Mason: Der Fall mit dem hässlichen Entlein
programme.desc: Als er versucht, einen skrupellosen Privatdetektiv davon zu überzeugen, dass Erpressung nichts bringt, wird Perry Mason in eine Mordanklage verwickelt.

programme.title: Perry Mason: Der Fall mit dem betäubten Piloten
programme.desc: Perry Mason wird damit beauftragt, sich um eine Steuerangelegenheit zu kümmern, und muss miterleben, wie seine hübsche Mandantin Janet Norris beschuldigt wird, ihren Ehemann mit Gift ermordet zu haben.

programme.title: Perry Mason: Der Fall mit der einäugigen Zeugin
programme.desc: Perry Mason wird dafür engagiert, eine Frau zu verteidigen, die in die Zahlung einer Erpressungsforderung verwickelt ist und schon bald wegen eines Doppelmordes angeklagt wird – doch Perry ist überzeugt, dass sie ihn nicht begangen hat.

programme.title: Perry Mason: Der Fall mit dem tödlichen Albtraum
programme.desc: Perry Mason befindet sich in einer der ungewöhnlichsten Situationen, die er im Laufe seiner Karriere erlebt hat, als er beauftragt wird, einen Mandanten wegen Mordes zu verteidigen, bevor sich überhaupt ein Mord ereignet hat.

programme.title: Perry Mason: Der Fall mit der leeren Blechbüchse
programme.desc: Ein einfacher Erbschaftsfall wird zum Mordfall, als Masons Mandant mit einer Waffe in der Hand in einem verschlossenen Raum neben einer Leiche aufgefunden wird.

programme.title: Derrick: Rachefeldzug
programme.desc: Auf Oberinspektor Derrick wird ein Anschlag verübt. Wenig später findet Derrick in seiner Post die Todesanzeige des Strafgefangenen Eduardo Renzi, den er hinter Gitter gebracht hatte ...

programme.title: Derrick: Schrei in der Nacht
programme.desc: Suche nach dem Mörder einer Prostituierten, die im Englischen Garten erwürgt wurde.

programme.title: Derrick: Die Kälte des Lebens
programme.desc: Als Libeta die Prostituierte zufällig den Waschraum der Herrentoilette des Orion-Clubs betritt, findet sie dort den ermordeten Zuhälter Rossner. So erzählt sie es Oberinspektor Derrick, aber schon am nächsten Tag widerruft sie ihre Aussage.

programme.title: Derrick: Mozart und der Tod
programme.desc: Auf dem Heimweg von einer Unterrichtsstunde zur U-Bahn wird die 17jährige Geigerin Marion Scholz überfallen und vergewaltigt; ihren Freund, den Musiklehrer Justus Roth, schlagen die Betrunkenen zusammen.

programme.title: Derrick: Ein kleiner Gauner
programme.desc: Bei der Aufklärung der Ermordung eines Physik-Professors wird Taschendieb Alfred, genannt Ali, für Oberinspektor Derrick zum wichtigen Zeugen, weil er bei einem Einbruch unfreiwillig zum Mitwisser des Mordplanes unter drei Männern geworden ist.

programme.title: Der Alte: Verwischte Spuren
programme.desc: Herr Gebele nimmt in der Telefonzentrale der Feuerwache das letzte Lebenszeichen einer Frau entgegen. Später sagt er: "Ja also, die Frau hat angerufen, grad' bevor der ins Haus eingedrungen ist. Ich hab' die Scheibe noch klirren gehört."

programme.title: Der Alte: Ultimo
programme.desc: Auf Albert Kosak ist ein Mordanschlag verübt worden. Obwohl er in dritter Ge- neration auf hohem Niveau mit Immobilien handelt und mit seinen 65 Jahren auf Korrektheit bedacht ist, scheint es Menschen zu geben, die ihn beseitigen wollen.

programme.title: Der Alte: Ein teuflischer Plan
programme.desc: Georg Bergmeister hat sein ererbtes Vermögen bei verschiedenen "Geschäften" nach und nach aufgezehrt. Dem erst kürzlich eingestellten Diener Bernhard hat er schon drei Monate keinen Lohn mehr zahlen können.

programme.title: Der Alte: Die letzte Nacht
programme.desc: Die Entlassung von Hans Steiger, der wegen Vergewaltigung an Elisabeth Bossek verturteilt wurde, aus der Haft scheint nicht nur für Kommissar Kress von Interesse zu sein.

programme.title: Der Kommissar: Ein Mord auf dem Lande
programme.desc: Der Gastwirt Alfons Tolke ist einer der reichsten Männer des kleinen Dorfes, und das gibt ihm - so meint er - das Recht, mit den Bewohnern umzuspringen, wie es ihm beliebt.

programme.title: Der Kommissar: Die Kusine
programme.desc: Der Mord an dem Werbegrafiker Heinz Brenner ist für Kommissar Keller und sein Team zunächst eine reine Routineangelegenheit. Als dann aber die Freunde angeben, dass ein ganz junges Mädchen zuletzt mit ihm gesehen wurde, erscheint der Fall sehr mysteriös.

programme.title: Der Kommissar: Sturz aus großer Höhe
programme.desc: Als Kommissar Keller an einem Morgen den toten Mann erblickt, der durch einen Sturz von der Fassade eines Hochhauses ums Leben gekommen ist, hat er keine Zweifel, dass ein tollkühner Einbrecher in Ausübung seiner Tätigkeit verunglückt ist.

programme.title: Der Kommissar: Noch zehn Minuten zu leben
programme.desc: Im Hause des Industriellen Lenhard findet eine Party statt. Der Gastgeber ist durch ein Telefongespräch aufgehalten worden, eielt aber nach oben, um sich umzuziehen. Wenige Sekunden später wird die Partygesellschaft durch einen Schuss aufgeschreckt.

programme.title: Sabrina - Total verhext!: Katzenhorror
programme.desc: Es ist Halloween. Als Sabrina sich in ihrem neuen Job im Café eingewöhnt, wird es schaurig.

programme.title: Sabrina - Total verhext!: Ein irres Fest
programme.desc: Halloween wird zu einem wahrhaft gruseligen Ereignis, als eine verrückte Puppe das Kommando über die Feierlichkeiten übernimmt.

programme.title: Sabrina - Total verhext!: Sabrina hat die Hosen an
programme.desc: Die Geheimnisse der Männer werden gelüftet, als Sabrina sich als Junge ausgibt, um herauszufinden, wie Männer denken.

programme.title: Sabrina - Total verhext!: Party-Time
programme.desc: Halloween entpuppt sich in der Tat als eine gruselige Nacht, als Sabrina und ihre Tanten versuchen, eine normale Party zu veranstalten.

programme.title: Sabrina - Total verhext!: Halloween, ein Festtag für Hexen
programme.desc: Sabrina beschließt, ihre eigene Geisterparty zu veranstalten, die zur Party des Jahres wird.

programme.title: Sabrina - Total verhext!: Mord im Halloween-Express
programme.desc: Hilda und Zelda werden zu einer Krimi-Party im Halloween-Mystery-Train eingeladen, der in Boston Halt macht.

programme.title: Cheers: Die Nacht des Grauens
programme.desc: Carla sucht ein hübsches, bezahlbares Haus. Cliff gibt ihr einen heißen Tip. Carla ist begeistert und kauft das günstige Eigenheim sofort. Norm ist angesichts des niedrigen Preises misstrauisch.

programme.title: Cheers: Krieg der Kneipen – Teil 5
programme.desc: Es ist Halloween. Sam möchte seinem Erzfeind Gary einen gehörigen Streich spielen. Der erscheint jedoch plötzlich im Cheers und bittet um Waffenstillstand. Sein Arzt hat ihm einen zu hohen Blutdruck attestiert. Ein Schreck könnte tödliche Folgen haben.

programme.title: Cheers: Alptraum im Alptraum
programme.desc: Diane büffelt bis tief in die Nacht für ihr Examen. Dabei nickt sie in Sams Büro ein. Plötzlich ein Schrei: Diane hat geträumt, der geisteskranke Andy, der sie einst umbringen wollte, sei wieder frei.

programme.title: Cheers: Cliffs erstes Rendezvous
programme.desc: Stammgast Cliff hat Schwierigkeiten mit den Frauen: Er ist sehr schüchtern. Bei einem Maskenball lernt er endlich eine Dame kennen. Die beiden verabreden sich für den nächsten Tag, um zu erfahren, wie sie ohne Masken aussehen.

programme.title: Die Nordsee von oben
programme.desc: Die deutsche Nordseeküste aus der Vogelperspektive: Die Dokumentation zeigt Luftaufnahmen vom Weltnaturerbe Wattenmeer, den Inseln und Halligen und vom Land hinter dem Deich.

programme.title: Die deutsche Nordseeküste: Von Borkum nach Hamburg
programme.desc: Die Cineflex-Kamera zeigt die Besonderheiten des Wattenmeeres. Die Insel Lütje Hörn sieht von eben betrachtet aus wie ein Embryo. Und auch am Boden gibt es einige Besonderheiten zu entdecken…

programme.title: Die deutsche Nordseeküste: Von Hamburg zu den Halligen
programme.desc: Von Deutschlands einziger Hochseeinsel Helgoland bis zu den Halligen vor der Küste Nordfrieslands. Im Nationalpark Wattenmeer eröffnet sich dem Zuschauer eine einzigartige Welt.

programme.title: Die deutsche Nordseeküste: Von den Halligen nach Sylt
programme.desc: Es geht auf die größte Hallig: Langeneß. Postschiffer Fiede Nissen ist die Nabelschnur zur Zivilisation. Über die Halbinsel Nordstrand führt die Reise weiter auf die Inseln Sylt, Föhr und Amrum, auch „die drei Schwestern“ genannt.

programme.title: Die Ostsee von oben
programme.desc: Ebenso wie Frankreich grenzt Deutschland an zwei Meere, die unterschiedlicher nicht sein könnten. Während die Nordsee die wilde Kälte des Atlantiks mit sich führt, gilt die Ostsee als...

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Ein Maler wird tot in seinem Atelier gefunden.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Das Team beschäftigt sich mit einem 15 Jahre alten Mordfall.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Als eine schwangere Frau brutal niedergeschlagen wird, hängt ihr Leben und das ihres Kindes am seidenen Faden.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Als Elodie Forget und ihr Baby spurlos verschwinden, gerät zunächst Elodies Ehemann Baptiste in Verdacht.

programme.title: Der Chef

programme.title: Der Chef

programme.title: Der Chef
programme.desc: In Montreal flammt für den Chef eine alte Liebe auf. Gleichzeitig bekommt er es mit Bombenanschlägen und einem internationalen Raubüberfall zu tun.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Little People
programme.desc: Oliver Crangle ist ein verbitterter, voreingenommener Mann. Er beabsichtigt, um vier Uhr durch unbekannte Mittel jeden bösen Menschen auf der Welt zu schrumpfen.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Invasion der Zwerge
programme.desc: Eine alte Frau trifft in einem abgelegenen Bauernhaus auf winzige, feindselige Außerirdische.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Einer zuviel
programme.desc: Soldaten folgen Spuren, die von einem zugefrorenen Teich in ein Diner führen. Darin finden sie einen Softdrink-Zapfer, einen Busfahrer und seine sieben Passagiere. Der Busfahrer ist sich sicher, dass nur sechs Personen in seinen Bus eingestiegen sind …

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nummer 12 sieht aus wie Du
programme.desc: In einer Zukunft, in der sich jeder Mensch im Alter von 19 Jahren einer Operation unterziehen muss, die ihn mit allen anderen Menschen identisch macht, versucht eine Frau verzweifelt, an ihrer eigenen Identität festzuhalten.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Ein Halbschwergewicht aus Stahl
programme.desc: Der Boxroboter „Battling Maxo“ hat vor dem geplanten Kampf eine Panne, also muss sein Manager seinen Platz einnehmen.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Das Buch der Kanamiter
programme.desc: Der alte Ben, der sich in alles verwandeln kann, versucht, einem körperlich beeinträchtigten kleinen Mädchen zu helfen.

programme.title: Outer Limits – Die unbekannte Dimension
programme.desc: Als ein High-Tech-Hochhaus plötzlich verrückt spielt, sind die zuvor isolierten Nachbarn gezwungen, Hand in Hand zu arbeiten, um zu überleben.

programme.title: Outer Limits – Die unbekannte Dimension
programme.desc: In einer von Aliens beherrschten Gesellschaft entdeckt eine Elektronikerin, dass die menschlichen Mitarbeiter der Aliens in Wahrheit Maschinen sind.

programme.title: Ein Fall für Zwei
programme.desc: Rechtsanwalt Dr. Lessing unterstützt Matulas sportliche Ambitionen und fährt ihn zu seinem Fitness-Studio. Dort angekommen scheint alles wie immer zu sein.

programme.title: Ein Fall für Zwei
programme.desc: Kurz vor Ladenschluss ist Privatdetektiv Matula in einer besonderen Mission unterwegs: Er begleitet seinen Auftraggeber Ralf Stecher.

programme.title: Ein Fall für Zwei
programme.desc: Es ist mal wieder Dr. Lessings Qualitäten als Rechtsanwalt zu verdanken, dass Christian Keller freigesprochen wurde.

programme.title: Ein Fall für Zwei
programme.desc: Als Dr. Lessing in seinem Lieblingsrestaurant eintrifft und sich auf einen gemütlichen Abend freut, ahnt er nicht, dass dieser Besuch für die Aufklärung eines Mordes entscheidend sein wird.

programme.title: Don Matteo

programme.title: Der Fahnder
programme.desc: Anlässlich seines 30-jährigen Dienstjubiläums lädt Rick das Team zum Kuchenessen ein. Doch das Beisammensein wird jäh unterbrochen: Im Wald ist ein junges Mädchen tot aufgefunden worden.

programme.desc: Gudrun vergnügt sich mit Restaurantbesitzer Gröstl, als diesem eine Kugel in den Kopf gejagt wird. Sie beschuldigt ihren Mann aus Eifersucht. Weitere Morde folgen.

programme.title: Vier Frauen und ein Todesfall
programme.desc: Herta wird erstickt in ihrem Krankenbett aufgefunden. Die Klinik-Psychologin Sigrun tickt selbst nicht richtig. Das Quartett findet eine Verbindung zu Sigruns totem Bruder.

programme.title: Vier Frauen und ein Todesfall
programme.desc: Hertas Leiche wird vom Ex-Pfarrer aus dem See gefischt - in einem Eisblock eingefroren. Frosti und Toni wollten nach Südkorea, um ihre Ehefrauen klonen zu lassen.

programme.title: Vier Frauen und ein Todesfall
programme.desc: Dr. Klaus besucht seine Patientin Bernadette zu Hause. Die vier Frauen finden Bernadette tot vor und Dr. Klaus gefesselt und unter Drogeneinfluss daneben am Piano sitzend.

programme.title: Schnell Ermittelt
programme.desc: Stefan vermutet hinter dem Selbstmord eines Schülers einen Mord - Angelika bestätigt dies. Hinweise auf einen geplanten Amoklauf machen den Fall brisant: Die Ermittlungen werden zu einem Wettlauf gegen die Zeit, um den Täter zu stoppen.

programme.title: Schnell Ermittelt
programme.desc: Fotomodel Elsa Gorger wird tot mit verätztem Gesicht gefunden. War es der eifersüchtige Freund oder Neid im Modelbusiness? Für Angelika steht fest: Jemand wollte nicht nur töten, sondern Elsas Schönheit für immer zerstören.

programme.title: Schnell Ermittelt
programme.desc: Hausfrau Laura Czerny stirbt plötzlich - in der Villensiedlung mochte sie nicht jeder. Angelika fragt sich: Was hat Laura getan oder gewusst, um so gehasst zu werden? Nebenbei plagt sie der Verdacht, dass ihre Affäre mit einem Serienmörder Folgen hat.

programme.title: Schnell Ermittelt
programme.desc: Niko Hartmann stirbt durch Kontakt mit einem Flugzeugrotor - Unfall oder Mord? Stefan untersucht die ungewöhnliche Todesart, während Angelika gegen Selbstüberschätzung, Proporz und Machtspielchen kämpft - oft ohne am längeren Ast zu sitzen.

programme.title: Schnell Ermittelt
programme.desc: Banker Simon Koller wird in seinem Auto ermordet. Für Angelika eine willkommene Flucht vor dem Mittagessen mit der Ex-Schwiegermutter. Trotz familiärer Konflikte führt eine neue Spur zu einer Lektion über Liebe, Demut und Urteilskraft.

programme.title: Kommissar Rex

programme.title: Kommissar Rex

programme.title: Kommissar Rex

programme.title: Kommissar Rex
programme.desc: Diesmal gilt es für Fabbri, einen Anschlag der internationalen Waffenlobby zu verhindern, die eine Tagung zum Verbot von Landminen attackieren möchte. Das rechtzeitige Auffinden der Bombe scheint hoffnungslos - bis Rex' Spürnase anschlägt.

programme.title: Kommissar Rex
programme.desc: Tony, Sohn aus reichem Hause, wird auf seiner opulenten Geburtstagsfeier erstochen. Sein Bruder wird vermisst. Ein verdächtiger Freund kommt zu Tode. Fabbri will mit Rex' Hilfe herausfinden, was bei den verwöhnten Jugendlichen los ist.

programme.title: Kommissar Rex
programme.desc: Als Gräfin Clotilde von der Terrasse stürzt, deutet alles auf Mord hin, zumal eine Obdachlose unmittelbar nach dem Vorfall aus dem Haus gerannt kam. Fabbri und Rex recherchieren im Obdachlosenmillieu und erleben eine Überraschung.
